entries.input: Let $m$ and $n$ be coprime positive integers and put $a_k = \lfloor mk/n \rfloor - \lfloor m(k-1)/n \rfloor$ for $k = 1, \dots, n$. Prove that if $g$ and $h$ are elements of a group and $g h^{a_1} g h^{a_2} \cdots g h^{a_n}$ is the identity, then $gh = hg$.
entries.name: Putnam2018A4
entries.binders: {G : Type*} [Group G] (m n : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) (hn : 0 < n) (hmn : Nat.Coprime m n) (g h : G) (hprod : ((List.range n).map (fun k => g * h ^ (m * (k + 1) / n - m * k / n))).prod = 1)
entries.title: Putnam 2018 A4
entries.witness_note: `{G : Type*}` is implicit and `[Group G]` is an instance binder; `∃` can bind neither, so the A6 form `∃ <binders>, True` does not exist for this entry.
